notes: Hand-curated synthetic fixture for the ML research-adjacent product manager archetype. One ExpectedUnit per fact-bearing bullet in the EXPERIENCE + SIDE PROJECTS sections.

expected_units.normalized_summary: Productionized first long-context personalization model into the consumer assistant — drove eval design, rollout-stage gating, and pre-launch red-team plan; shipped to 100% of paid users with +14% helpfulness eval lift
Designed and ran the offline eval suite for the personalization release — 7 capability slices, 3 safety slices, plus a held-out user-simulation slice; now the team's standing release gate

Owned the spec for user-facing memory feature exposing the personalization model — shipped read/edit/pin UX, drove privacy review, launched memory-on-by-default with explicit opt-out approved by policy

Led cross-functional working group on refusal calibration with three research scientists — built measurement framework distinguishing safety-relevant refusals from over-cautious ones; now the standard refusal eval used by two adjacent teams
Co-authored internal playbook for shipping research artifacts — eval gates, red-team requirements, rollout staging, and the research-to-product handoff template; adopted by four product teams
Shipped structured-output API surface — constrained-decoding interface that pins a JSON schema; +$8M net-new ARR within two quarters, adopted by 41% of top-100 API customers

Led rollout of second-generation transformer-based ranker for Reels — owned experiment design and staged-traffic rollout; +6.1% time-spent across four largest markets and +2.4% on fairness metrics in smaller-language locales

Designed and shipped creator-value objective head — ranking signal rewarding distribution to early-stage creators; -0.3% watch-time tradeoff for +18% in distinct creators served per week and creator-side retention lift
Owned integrity workstream for Reels ranking — reduced policy-violating content prevalence by 38% via candidate-generation filter, re-ranker penalty model, and review-routing change
Replaced aging offline-replay tool with counterfactual eval framework based on logged-policy importance sampling — eval cycle time for a new ranking model dropped from 3 weeks to 4 days
Led introduction of embedding-based candidate generator for Instagram Search alongside inverted-index lookup — +11% on long-tail recall without measurable precision regression on head queries
Shipped Instagram Search trending-now surface — required real-time aggregation pipeline and re-ranker that explicitly demoted historical-but-stale queries
Built and open-sourced evalbench — a Python eval harness for hobby model fine-tunes with capability slices, regression baselines, and GitHub Actions integration
Published 14 reproducible LoRA fine-tuning notebooks on small public datasets with explicit eval baselines as a teaching resource
